result.summary: Both slots pass. Slot a (E slot, core day_centroid(Volume)) gets novelty 3 and soundness 4. I struck seeds 1, 2 and 13, the cross_med level versions. Their |ρ| with the known family cross_mean(day_std(Amt),30) is 0.538, 0.558 and 0.526, and §1 disqualifies anything at 0.5 or above. 11 seeds remain. Slot b (N slot, intraday price-volume correlation) gets novelty 4 and soundness 4. I struck seed 11, cross_stddev of day_corr, which mostly measures liquidity (|ρ| 0.548 with the known family). 11 seeds remain. I checked every operator in the source code and found no maths problems. Minor caveats are recorded in the file: (1) the BoardCode bucket ranking really splits stocks into blocks by board, then by stock code, not strictly within each board. (2) Seeds a12 and a14 use the same set of operators outside the core and may be rejected as duplicates. (3) in_rank breaks ties by minute order, so in stretches where the price is stuck at the limit, seed b4 picks up how volume changes over time. (4) In seeds b7 and b8 the VWAP/TWAP ratio sits close to 1 in float32. This causes a few ties, but they do not dominate the cross-section. (5) abs_ in seed a11 is redundant. (6) Seed b3 is nearly the same as seed b2. This round has no R groups.
